stem.text: A $20\,\text{V}$ d.c. supply is connected to a circuit consisting of five resistors L, M, N, P and Q.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram of five resistors, labelled L, M, N, P and Q, in a network connected to a supply; L is marked 7 V drop, N is marked 4 V drop, and a 20 V rise is marked on the supply.

stem.text: There is a potential drop of $7\,\text{V}$ across L and a further $4\,\text{V}$ potential drop across N.
What are the potential drops across M, P and Q?
